Designed for construction sites, events, parking lots, and emergency response, these rugged, weather-resistant units provide 24/7 surveillance with high-definition cameras, motion detection, night vision, and remote access. Powered by solar energy, battery backup, or hybrid solutions, they ensure uninterrupted monitoring even in off-grid locations. With real-time alerts, cloud storage, and remote management, this cutting-edge mobile security solution helps protect against theft, vandalism, and unauthorized access—bringing reliable, on-the-go security to any environment. Learn more Wireless Autonomous Surveillance Platform (WASP) The WASP (Wireless Autonomous Surveillance Platform) is a cutting-edge, all-weather surveillance solution designed for both temporary and permanent installations. Equipped with high-definition cameras housed in a rugged, weatherproof enclosure, WASP provides reliable security monitoring in even the most challenging environments.
